conbody.p: You can set the parking distance warning with the vehicle is in DRIVE READY at low speeds. To use Parking Distance Warning Auto On function, with the vehicle is in DRIVE READY, select SettingsVehicleDriver assistanceParking safetyAuto PDW (Parking Distance Warning) on the infotainment system.

note.p: When Auto PDW (Parking Distance Warning) is selected, the Parking Safety button indicator () stays on.
